description: Relative Value & Spread Evolution Radar by Office Solution The Relative Value & Spread Evolution Radar provides institutional-grade multi-factor comparison and spread tracking in Power BI. It plots multiple securities, strategies, or portfolios across polygonal radar spokes to evaluate relative valuation, risk metrics, liquidity, and performance factors simultaneously. Powered by an integrated chronological Play Axis engine, it brings static radar charts to life by animating shape migrations over time with fading historical lookback trails and directional vertex motion paths. Key Concepts: Multi-Dimensional Spoke Geometry: Compares instruments concurrently across 3 or more quantitative metrics (e.g., Z-Scores, Basis Spreads, Convexity, Carry, Liquidity). Historical Evolution Trails: Renders fading historical polygon footprints and vertex trajectory paths across past observation periods to visualize how valuation profiles shift over time. Dual Scaling Engine: Supports both Normalized (0–100%) mode to harmonize heterogeneous metrics (e.g., bp vs. ratios) on a single radar, and Raw / Absolute mode with spoke-specific min-max bounds. Benchmark / Neutral Reference: Overlays an ideal peer-group target or neutral benchmark polygon with automated delta variance tracking.
